identity_hint.display_name: J.T. Holub / James Holub Equine Services

source_candidates.evidence_excerpt: As a professional farrier I've dedicated my career to continuing my education... My preference is to emphasize the basic fundamentals to properly 'balance' the equine digit... I believe it is this emphasis of focusing on the trim and proper shoe placement that allows me to keep most of the horses in my care working to the best of their ability with just four plain shoes.

source_candidates.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - Lameness section
source_candidates.evidence_excerpt: Your equine athletes work hard. And while I feel the best way to deal with lameness is to do everything possible to prevent it in the first place... My intention is to utilize every aspect of my continued education to get your horse sound as soon as possible so both of you can go back to work.

source_candidates.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - Glue-On Shoes section
source_candidates.evidence_excerpt: I've been successfully applying Polyflex, Sigafoos, and Direct Glue Aluminum shoes for over a decade.

source_candidates.source_name: James Holub Equine Services - About page
source_candidates.evidence_excerpt: After growing up around Thoroughbreds and handling race horses for most of his early life, in 2003 J.T. attended Casey & Son's Farrier School in Resaca, GA. After graduating he served an apprenticeship in Ocala, Florida with a farrier that focused on therapeutic shoeing. Following his apprenticeship J.T. went on to be a licenced track farrier at Presque Isle Downs, Mountaineer Racetrack, and Thistledown for 5 years... J.T. moved to Kentucky to focus on shoeing upper level sport horses... he continues to follow the major show jumping and dressage circuits from Kentucky to Wellington and abroad developing hoofcare solutions for sport horses at the highest levels of competition.
